tasks.subject: Task 1: Project scaffold
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Root xtool package and nested RunCore package that both build, with a placeholder screen.

**Files:**
- Package.swift
- xtool.yml
- Info.plist
- RunCore/Package.swift
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Pace/Pace.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/PaceTests.swift
- Sources/RunPlan/App/RunPlanApp.swift
- Sources/RunPlan/App/RootView.swift
- Sources/RunPlan/Resources/beep.wav

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Pace tests pass
- [ ] xtool dev build writes xtool/RunPlan.app
- [ ] Built Info.plist has UIBackgroundModes audio

**Verify:** swift test in RunCore via WSL and xtool dev build via WSL

Full steps and code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-12-foundation-guided-workouts.md

tasks.subject: Task 3: Workout engine
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wall-clock workout engine ported from PaceKeeper with distance steps and checkpoints.

**Files:**
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Engine/
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Models/ActiveWorkout.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/StepExpanderTests.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/StepResolverTests.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/WorkoutEngineTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Repeat groups expand correctly
- [ ] Resolution correct at boundaries and after long gaps
- [ ] Skips safe at first and last step
- [ ] Distance steps wait for manual advance
- [ ] Restored running checkpoint comes back paused

**Verify:** swift test in RunCore via WSL

Full steps and code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-12-foundation-guided-workouts.md

```json:metadata
{"files":["RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Engine/","RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Models/ActiveWorkout.swift","RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/StepExpanderTests.swift","RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/StepResolverTests.swift","RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/WorkoutEngineTests.swift"],"verifyCommand":"swift test in RunCore via WSL","acceptanceCriteria":["Repeat groups expand correctly","Resolution correct at boundaries and after long gaps","Skips safe at first and last step","Distance steps wait for manual advance","Restored running checkpoint comes back paused"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Cue scheduling and wording
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Decide from snapshots when to announce, beep and finish, and what to say.

**Files:**
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Cues/
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/CueSchedulerTests.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/CueTextTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Each step announced once, again after skip back
- [ ] Beeps once at 3, 2, 1, never while paused
- [ ] finished fires once
- [ ] Treadmill wording in mph, outdoor in pace

**Verify:** swift test in RunCore via WSL

Full steps and code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-12-foundation-guided-workouts.md

